messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: p95 latency SLO breach on inference-router (latency-first policy). Triggered automated reroute attempts to alternate regions. page=oncall-priya priority=sev2
Priya (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Paging SREs and runtime. Any customer-facing errors?
Daniel (SRE): seeing a spike in route-change events, looks like quick toggles between us-west-2 and eu-central-1. p95 across the cluster jumped from ~220ms -> 1.3s. Some 503 retries observed.
Elena (runtime): thanks. I'm pulling the routing decision logs now. Initial hypothesis: policy hit p95 threshold and weights shifted to fallback variant; that load caused queuing upstream and p95 re-tripped -> bounce.
Marco (prod-eng): can we freeze routing-policy automated rollouts to stop oscillation? If we disable automatic reroute we'll avoid thrash.
Priya (oncall): yes please. Action: disable 'latency-first' auto-fallback for inference-router. Marco, can you apply a manual freeze?
Marco (prod-eng): doing it now. /deploy-config apply --path svc/inference-router/policies/latency-first --set automated=false
SRE-Bot: command accepted. Configuration change queued, will take ~30s to propagate.
Daniel (SRE): logs while freeze propagates:
```
[2026-11-03T10:24:12Z] route_eval user:api token=**** policy=latency-first p95=1320ms trigger=true target_region=eu-central-1
[2026-11-03T10:24:13Z] reroute start -> eu-central-1 variant=v2-quant
[2026-11-03T10:24:14Z] queue_depth us-west-2=1200 eu-central-1=900
[2026-11-03T10:24:17Z] p95 eu-central-1=1450ms trigger=true policy=latency-first
[2026-11-03T10:24:18Z] reroute start -> ap-southeast-1 variant=v1
```
Priya (oncall): looks like reroutes are cascading across regions and model variants. Note the variants differ (v2-quant vs v1) — could be mismatch causing slower responses.
Elena (runtime): good catch. The policy allows cross-variant fallback if region's preferred variant not available. That means we can land on a slower model unexpectedly. If the slower model increases latency, it re-triggers.
Daniel (SRE): I'm seeing a feedback loop: policy moves traffic to region B, region B increases p95 because of variant mismatch or cold caches, policy moves traffic elsewhere -> repeat.
Marco (prod-eng): mitigation plan: 1) freeze auto-fallback (done). 2) restrict cross-variant fallback so routing only switches regions for compatible variants. 3) backfill caches on the target variant to reduce cold-start p95.
Priya (oncall): I'm going to notify customer-success for the active customers in affected regions and add incident banner. Suggested msg: "We are investigating elevated latency in certain regions; mitigation in progress."
SRE-Bot: incident.incident1234 created by Priya (oncall). Severity: S2. Current status: mitigating.
Elena (runtime): I'm preparing a targeted cache-warm job for v2-quant in eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-1. Running a small fanout of synthetic warm requests to KV caches and model priming. ETA ~6m.
Daniel (SRE): running a tracing query to identify high-latency code paths. early signs point to increased token decode time on v2-quant under the incoming request shape.
Priya (oncall): update: freeze propagated. automated fallback disabled at 10:27:03Z.
Marco (prod-eng): changing policy config to disallow variant switching: /deploy-config patch --policy latency-first --set allow_variant_fallback=false
SRE-Bot: patch accepted, rolling to config service (3 nodes).
Elena (runtime): warm-up job started. Using small prompts to prime KV cache and gpu kernels. logs: 
```
warm: started region=eu-central-1 variant=v2-quant batch=8
warm: 2000 priming requests queued
warm: 1xx success, avg latency 120ms
```
Daniel (SRE): CPU/RAM/GPU metrics trending back toward normal, queue depths dropping. p95 in eu-central-1 down to ~340ms from 1.45s.
Priya (oncall): good. Any 5xx residuals?
Daniel (SRE): minimal 503s, mostly retries resolved. No new errors after freeze.
Marco (prod-eng): after warm and policy patch, we should observe stable routing. I'm keeping automated fallback disabled for 30 minutes and then will perform a controlled canary that only allows region changes when variant compatibility is satisfied.
Priya (oncall): customer-impact note: "We observed elevated p95 and increased retry rates for requests routed to fallback regions between 10:24-10:30Z. Customers may have seen transient latency spikes; no data loss reported." Posting to status page now.
Priya (oncall): @Incident Bot can you escalate to MGRs if we don't resolve in 45m?
Incident Bot: ack — will escalate at +45m if status remains mitigating.
Elena (runtime): follow-up: creating a short-term guard in the routing service to compute an expected-compatibility score before rerouting. If score < 0.8, skip region fallback. Will push a hotfix today.
Daniel (SRE): note for postmortem: root cause likely policy threshold sensitivity combined with cross-variant fallback and cold caches on quantized variant. Action items: tighten policy hysteresis, add variant-compatibility checks, improve cache priming on failover, add observability metric for variant-switch events.
Marco (prod-eng): agreed. I'll schedule a runbook update and a production safety test for routing policies.
Priya (oncall): closing loop for now — continuing to monitor. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: monitoring alert suppressed for this incident window.
Priya (oncall): last note: timeline will be included in the incident ticket. thanks team.
